issues.legal_issue: A person who did not seek a reference may apply for redetermination of compensation on the basis of any qualifying court award made after the redetermination procedure became available, rather than only the first such award.
material_facts: Land was acquired under common notifications, and some landowners obtained enhanced compensation through court references.
The applicants had not sought references against the Collector’s awards and applied for redetermination based on court awards concerning land covered by the same notifications.
The applications were made within three months of the particular awards on which the applicants relied.
issues.conclusion: The limitation period runs from the award on which redetermination is sought. An applicant may rely on any qualifying award made after the procedure became available, provided the statutory conditions are met and the applicant makes only one application.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 28-A(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, read in light of its stated purpose of reducing inequality in compensation for similarly situated landowners, the relevant award is any award under Part III allowing compensation above the Collector’s award, not necessarily the first such award after Section 28-A came into force. The application must be made within three months of the relied-on award, concern other land covered by the same notification, be made by a person who did not apply for a reference, and be the applicant’s only application. A beneficial provision should be construed to advance its purpose; the Court relied on Jnan Ranjan Sen Gupta v. Arun Kumar Bose and rejected the contrary approach in Babua Ram v. State of U.P. and Union of India v. Karnail Singh.

predicates.land_acquisition_redetermination_applica: A person seeks redetermination of compensation for acquired land through the procedure available to a person who did not seek a reference.
predicates.court_award_after_procedure_available: A court made the relied-on award after the redetermination procedure became available.
predicates.award_grants_more_than_collector_awarded: The court award allows the claimant in the reference more compensation than the Collector awarded.
predicates.applicant_land_covered_by_same_notificat: The applicant’s land is covered by the same acquisition notification as the land addressed in the relied-on award.
predicates.applicant_did_not_seek_reference: The applicant did not apply for a reference against the Collector’s award.
predicates.application_within_three_months_of_relie: The applicant applied within three months of the award on which the application is based, subject to the applicable computation rules.
predicates.applicant_has_made_only_one_application: The applicant has made no more than one application for redetermination under this procedure.

issues.definition: When a person seeking redetermination meets each stated condition, the person may rely on the qualifying court award identified in the application.

issues.legal_issue: A Collector determining additional compensation through the statutory redetermination process may award interest on that additional compensation.
material_facts: The Collector made an award determining additional compensation after an application for redetermination.
The statutory process allowed a person who did not accept the Collector’s award to require the matter to be referred to a court, with the provisions governing references applying to that process.
The dispute concerned whether the Collector could award interest on the additional compensation.
issues.conclusion: The Collector may award interest on the additional compensation under the provision governing interest on the Collector’s award.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 28-A(2) and 28-A(3) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 provide for the Collector to make an award after inquiry and allow an unaccepting person to seek a court reference to which Sections 18 to 28 apply so far as may be. Because the Collector’s redetermination is an award within that process, Section 34 applies and permits the Collector to award interest on the additional compensation; Section 28, which empowers a court to award interest on excess compensation, does not preclude that result.

predicates.land_acquisition_redetermination_proceed: A person seeks redetermination of compensation for acquired land through a process in which the Collector determines compensation.
predicates.collector_makes_award_of_additional_comp: The Collector makes an award granting compensation beyond the amount previously awarded.
predicates.award_is_part_of_process_allowing_court_: The process permits a person who does not accept the Collector’s award to have the matter referred to a court for determination.

issues.definition: When the Collector awards additional compensation through a redetermination process that permits court reference, the Collector may award interest on that additional compensation.
